tesseractText:
Prepared as required by Financial Information Regulation, Schedule 1, section 7
Total payments for goods and services differ from the audited Financial Statements as the
Financial Statements are reduced for goods and services sales tax rebate. Depreciation of
fixed assets is recorded as an expenditure on the Financial Statements whereas the
Schedule includes fixed asset expenditures which are capitalized on the Financial
Statements. The Schedule may include expenditures which are wholly or partially
recovered or reimbursed from other organizations or employees thereby reducing the
district's operating expenditures in the Financial Statements.
